output.summary: Basellaceae is a family of herbaceous flowering plants native to tropical and subtropical parts of the Americas and Africa. All its species are climbing or trailing vines, although the food crops Basella alba and Ullucus tuberosus have been bred into more upright, compact forms. Three species produce tubers.
output.edibilityNote: The family includes two cultivated food species: Basella alba, known as Malabar spinach, and Ullucus tuberosus, known as ulluco.
